title: Headcount Per Department
description:
Report every department name and how many employees it has. Departments with **no employees** must still appear, with a count of 0.

Name the columns `department` and `employees`. Return the result in any order.
schemaSql:
CREATE TABLE departments (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  location TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE employees (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  title TEXT,
  salary INTEGER,
  dept_id INTEGER,
  manager_id INTEGER,
  hire_date TEXT
);
solutionSql:
SELECT d.name AS department, COUNT(e.id) AS employees
FROM departments d
LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.dept_id = d.id
GROUP BY d.id, d.name;
hint: COUNT(*) would count the NULL row a LEFT JOIN produces for an empty department. Count a column from the right table instead.
outputExplanation: Engineering has 4 employees, Sales has 3 and HR has 1.
